page.overview:
Who is Bobby Atwater?

Bobby Atwater was a skilled mercenary who worked as head of security aboard Duncan Kincaid's ship, the Essex. He and the rest of the crew were contracted by Martin Krebs to travel to Ile Saint-Hubert and collect DNA samples from the largest prehistoric species there in order to create a cure for heart disease.

Bobby Atwater arrived at Van Dijk's Bar & Grill in Suriname to a swarm of children. He picks one up and playfully turns one of them upside down. After that, he made his way to where Zora Bennett, Duncan Kincaid, and Martin Krebs were already talking. Being in on Zora and Duncan's plan double their pay from Krebs, Bobby feigns not being able to go on the mission. His act was unneeded though, because Krebs had already agreed to doubling it before he showed up. The first creature the team had their sights on was the Mosasaurus. It had been tagged by InGen years ago, and Martin Krebs had the equipment to track its location because his employer Parker-Genix bought InGen's data. Bobby was taking a look at his equipment which included a vial of liquid that he taps with his finger a few times. Henry Loomis questions him about it, and he tells him it's a neurotoxin that paralyzes its victim within seconds. Loomis did not like the implication of Atwater bringing this along, the implication being that he intended to use it on dinosaurs.

The radio aboard the Essex picks up a mayday signal sent by Reuben Delgado. When the team discusses whether to respond to it, Bobby asserts that going to these coordinates would set them back, and they should instead continue tracking the Mosasaurus and get what they need from it before responding to the signal. Krebs approves of his plan, but ultimately, Duncan made the call to respond to the signal immediately.

They eventually reached the family stranded at water on the hull of their overturned boat La Mariposa. Reuben, his daughters Teresa and Isabella, and Teresa's boyfriend Xavier Dobbs were let aboard the Essex.
